headline: Nigerian All-Share Index gains 0.47% as tech firm eTranzact surges 10%
summary: The Nigerian equities benchmark rose 1,200.24 points to close at 254,083.02, supported by a 10% advance in payment processor eTranzact.
why: The Nigerian Exchange (NGX) serves as the primary capital market venue in West Africa.

impacts.name: Nigerian Equities
impacts.why: Strength in technology shares helped drive overall stock index expansion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
